how_to_apply: Visit the UPSC Online Recruitment Application portal at upsconline.nic.in/ora
Complete Account creation, Universal Registration, and the Common Application Form (CAF) - these are common to all UPSC recruitments
Fill the post/vacancy-specific fourth module for the desired post within the application period
Upload photograph, live photo capture, and signature as per the specified instructions
Upload supporting documents/certificates for all claims made (date of birth, category, qualification, experience, disability, etc.)
Submit the application before the closing date; applications cannot be withdrawn or edited after submission
Take a printout of the finally submitted online application for future reference
important_instructions: Candidates are strongly advised to use their Aadhaar Card as the ID document for verification Correspondence, including interview schedules, will be sent only to the registered e-mail ID Mobile phones and other electronic/communication devices are strictly banned in the examination/interview hall Face authentication is mandatory for candidates at the examination venue/interview hall Furnishing false particulars or suppressing material information can lead to disqualification or debarment Candidates already in regular government service must submit a declaration that they have informed their Head of Office/Department before applying

Candidates holding a degree or postgraduate qualification in Engineering can also explore more Engineering Government Jobs and UPSC Govt Jobs available across India. Those with a background in Law can check the latest Law Government Jobs and Legal Officer Jobs for similar openings. Candidates qualified in Geography, Geology, or related sciences can browse more Research Officer Jobs and MSc Government Jobs matching their qualification. content_sections.text: The closing date for submission of the online application is also the date for determining eligibility of all candidates in every respect.

rows.date: Not specified in the notification; to be intimated separately

content_sections.heading: UPSC Vacancy 2026 - Post Details
content_sections.text: Posts 1, 3, and 4 are not reserved for any category but are identified as suitable for PwBD candidates. Post 6 and Post 7 are exclusively for Domiciles of the Union Territory of Ladakh.

content_sections.heading: UPSC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Desirable qualifications are also prescribed for most posts; these are relaxable at the discretion of the Commission for otherwise well-qualified candidates. Candidates are advised to verify complete eligibility details, including desirable qualifications, in the official notification before applying.

rows.essential_qualification: Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or equivalent (AMIE Section A&B enrolled up to 31.05.2013 also eligible)
rows.experience_required: 2 years' supervisory experience in design, maintenance and construction of structural and RCC works

rows.essential_qualification: Degree in Telecommunications/Electronics/Electronics & Communications Engineering (IETE or Section A&B of Institution of Engineers, enrolled up to 31.05.2013, also eligible)
rows.experience_required: 2 years' supervisory experience in radio aids to navigation

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Civil or Mechanical Engineering
rows.experience_required: 2 years' experience in civil engineering works (incl. harbour engineering) or maintenance/operation of cranes, diesel locos, marine engines and ancillary machines

rows.essential_qualification: Master's Degree in Law (or Bachelor's Degree in Law with longer experience, per two alternative routes in the notification) plus Hindi-medium schooling/Hindi as a subject condition
rows.experience_required: 2 years (Master's route) or 4 years (Bachelor's route) in judicial service, legal affairs, legal practice, law teaching, or Hindi translation/drafting of statutes

rows.essential_qualification: Master's Degree in Geography/Geology/Applied Geology/Geoinformatics/GIS & Remote Sensing/Geomatics/Geospatial Technology, with Geography or Geology studied in all years at bachelor's level
rows.experience_required: 5 years' experience in geographical/cartographical teaching or research involving data collection and map preparation

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor in Horticulture Science or Bachelor in Agriculture Science
BSc Agriculture/Horticulture, or BSc/MSc Soil Science, or BE/BTech Agricultural Engineering

content_sections.heading: UPSC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age relaxation of up to 10 years is available for PwBD candidates (subject to a maximum age of 56 years on the closing date) on posts identified as suitable, irrespective of whether the post is reserved for PwBD or not. Additional relaxations apply for Ex-Servicemen/Commissioned Officers and Central/UT Government employees as detailed in the notification. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: UPSC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: General/OBC/EWS male candidates: Rs. 25/- payable via Debit/Credit Card, UPI, or Internet Banking Female candidates, SC, ST, and PwBD candidates of any community: No fee Fee once paid is not refundable and cannot be carried forward to another examination or selection Applications submitted without the prescribed fee (where applicable) will be summarily rejected

content_sections.heading: UPSC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is made by interview, or by Recruitment Test (RT)/Combined Recruitment Test (CRT) followed by interview, depending on the post; the notification does not specify which mode applies to each individual post above. Category-wise minimum level of suitability in the interview (out of 100 marks) is UR-50, OBC-45, and SC/ST/PwBD-40. Where an RT is held, candidates must meet the minimum qualifying level at both the RT and interview stages.

content_sections.heading: UPSC Recruitment 2026 Documents Required
content_sections.text: Matriculation/10th Standard certificate or mark sheet showing date of birth Degree/Diploma certificate as proof of educational qualification (or provisional certificate with mark sheets) Order/letter for any equivalent qualification claimed Experience certificate(s) in prescribed proforma from Head(s) of Organisation(s)/Department(s) Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates, plus OBC non-creamy-layer declaration where applicable Certificate of Disability in prescribed proforma for PwBD candidates Documents for name change, if applicable Certificates for age relaxation claims (Ex-Servicemen, Central/UT Government employees, etc.) Domicile Certificate of Ladakh (for Horticulture Development Officer and Soil Conservation Assistant posts)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UPSC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the UPSC Online Recruitment Application portal at upsconline.nic.in/ora Complete Account creation, Universal Registration, and the Common Application Form (CAF) - these are common to all UPSC recruitments Fill the post/vacancy-specific fourth module for the desired post within the application period Upload photograph, live photo capture, and signature as per the specified instructions Upload supporting documents/certificates for all claims made (date of birth, category, qualification, experience, disability, etc.) Submit the application before the closing date; applications cannot be withdrawn or edited after submission Take a printout of the finally submitted online application for future reference

content_sections.heading: UPSC Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates are strongly advised to use their Aadhaar Card as the ID document for verification Correspondence, including interview schedules, will be sent only to the registered e-mail ID Mobile phones and other electronic/communication devices are strictly banned in the examination/interview hall Face authentication is mandatory for candidates at the examination venue/interview hall Furnishing false particulars or suppressing material information can lead to disqualification or debarment Candidates already in regular government service must submit a declaration that they have informed their Head of Office/Department before applying Candidates holding a degree or postgraduate qualification in Engineering can also explore more Engineering Government Jobs and UPSC Govt Jobs available across India. Those with a background in Law can check the latest Law Government Jobs and Legal Officer Jobs for similar openings. faq.question: Q1. What is UPSC Recruitment 2026 (Advt No. 10/2026)?
faq.answer: It is UPSC's online recruitment by selection to 7 posts, including Assistant Executive Engineer, Assistant Director, Superintendent Translation, Research Officer, Horticulture Development Officer, and Soil Conservation Assistant, with 34 total vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 34 vacancies are available across 7 posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 28th August 2026 for posts other than those under the Administration of UT of Ladakh, and 4th September 2026 for posts under the Administration of UT of Ladakh.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for UPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post, ranging from Bachelor's/Master's degrees in Engineering, Law, Geography/Geology, Horticulture, or Agriculture. See the Eligibility Criteria section above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Age limits vary by post and category, ranging from 30 to 40 years, with additional relaxation of up to 10 years for PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for UPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 25/- for general/OBC/EWS male candidates; no fee for Female, SC, ST, and PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for UPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply through upsconline.nic.in/ora by completing the URN registration, Common Application Form, and the post-specific module before the closing date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for UPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is by interview, or by Recruitment Test followed by interview, depending on the post, with category-wise minimum qualifying marks.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for UPSC Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Level 07 to Level 10 in the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q10. Are the Horticulture Development Officer and Soil Conservation Assistant posts open to all candidates?
faq.answer: No, these posts under UT of Ladakh are exclusively for Domiciles of the Union Territory of Ladakh, as per the Ladakh Civil Services Decentralization and Recruitment Rules, 2025.
